append_only: Fields of this pre-registration are never edited after commit to main. Corrections and clarifications are appended to amendments[] with a date and reason, before any VAL inference they could affect. A changed model, prompt, decoding, metric, sample, sharding rule or comparator is a new plan_id, not an amendment. An activated copy may differ from this file only in activated, activation and status; the runner compares every other field with the committed plan and refuses any difference.
must_not_run_until: Root review approves this plan and commits an activated copy (activated true, activation.activated_at, activation.approved_by) before the first VAL dispatch. The workflow and runner refuse anything else and require that copy's SHA256 as a dispatch input.

The PR plumbing job (three pinned TRAIN images, never scored) has passed on the commit to be activated, so the runner, model download and frozen evaluator path are known to work on a free GitHub-hosted runner.
scope: Named open-weight comparator on FGVC-Aircraft 2013b native VALIDATION only, run on free GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runners (no paid runners, no hosted API). No TEST image or TEST metadata is opened, downloaded, decoded or predicted: VAL stages fetch only image IDs listed in the committed native-VAL author manifest, and plumbing fetches only three pinned TRAIN IDs. No training.
why_ci: The Mac GPU is held by a live study; public-repository GitHub-hosted runners are free. A 3B-parameter model in bfloat16 (7.52 GB of weights) fits a 16 GB CPU runner; the 27B MLX baseline (docs/aircraft-named-baseline-plan-v1.json) does not.

baseline_identity.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (official bfloat16 weights), zero-shot, no adapter
baseline_identity.revision_evidence: Equal to MODEL_REVISIONS['Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct'] in the frozen evaluator's vlm_local_training.py at 85f0865, so the frozen _verified_model_directory accepts exactly this revision.
baseline_identity.license: Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT (non-commercial research or evaluation use); this is a research evaluation
baseline_identity.claim_label: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct zero-shot, bfloat16 on CPU, greedy, evaluator prompt and parser
baseline_identity.not_claimed: Not the strongest open-weight model or the strongest Qwen2.5-VL profile; not a tuned or few-shot baseline; not a TEST result. bfloat16 CPU numerics are not shown to equal float32 or GPU numerics.

evaluator_identity.plan_note: This is the evaluator bundle plan (sha256 cf871cfb..., equal to comparison.json plan_sha256). Its source_sha256 lists the 41 frozen evaluator files; every one equals the file at commit 85f0865 (git show | shasum -a 256, 2026-10-18). The runner materialises those 41 files from that commit, refuses on any byte difference, imports only them, and checks the SHA256 of every vision_rl module that actually executed.

reused_unchanged.prompt: vlm_local_training.prompt_text(spec, 'answer_only') through _processor and _inputs (same chat template file: chat_template.json sha256 ad60d902... is byte-identical in Qwen2-VL-2B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B at the pinned revisions)
reused_unchanged.predict: vlm_local_evaluation.Backend.predict, called on a Backend holding the named model instead of base+LoRA: greedy, _generation_kwargs(profile) = max_new_tokens 256, do_sample false, use_cache true; terminated iff the last generated token is an EOS id
reused_unchanged.parse: vlm_local_training.parse_label(response, labels, allow_reasoning=True) only when terminated, else None, exactly as run_chunk; the merge re-parses every raw response and refuses any difference, as compare does
reused_unchanged.deadline: vlm_local_evaluation._deadline per image; an interrupted image is unknown_after_interruption and never regenerated
reused_unchanged.pixels: aircraft_data.aircraft_pixel_sha256 checked against the author manifest's model_rgb_sha256 before every image, as run_chunk
reused_unchanged.metric: classification_comparison._score (mean diagonal of the row-normalised confusion; invalid and missing answers stay in class denominators) and compare_classification for paired comparisons

generation.profile_note: Identical to the evaluator study profile except dtype. num_generations, lora_rank and temperature are unused at inference (greedy, no adapter); they are kept so Profile.validate and the identity match the evaluator's.
generation.generation_config_override_reason: The pinned Qwen2.5-VL-3B generation_config.json sets repetition_penalty 1.05, which Backend.predict would apply under greedy decoding and which penalises copying label tokens that appear in the prompt's allowed list. The endpoints' base config (Qwen2-VL-2B @895c3a49) has repetition_penalty 1.0. Overriding to 1.0 makes decoding pure greedy, equal to the endpoints. Chosen before any inference.
deviations_from_endpoints: dtype bfloat16 on CPU instead of float32 on MPS: float32 weights (about 15 GB) do not fit a 16 GB runner
repetition_penalty override (above), which equalises rather than changes decoding

inputs.inputs_note: Byte copies of data/fgvc-aircraft-2013b/audit/val-images.json, development/validation.jsonl and candidates/fourshot-seed791/data_spec.json; the SHA256 values equal both the evaluator plan's input_sha256 and docs/aircraft-named-baseline-plan-v1.json (shasum -a 256, 2026-10-18).

image_mirror.verification: Every downloaded JPEG must match the author manifest's encoded_bytes and encoded_sha256 (the author archive's bytes), and its model-visible pixels its model_rgb_sha256; any difference refuses the shard. Spot check before registration: 3 of 3 VAL images (0034309, 0067396, 2227920) matched by curl + shasum -a 256 on 2026-10-18.

inputs.image_preprocessing: fgvc-aircraft-rgb-remove-bottom20-v1 via the frozen vlm_local_training._load_rgb (data_spec preprocessing_id)

plumbing.purpose: Prove on a free runner that pinned downloads, the frozen evaluator import, model load and Backend.predict work; record setup seconds and per-image latency. Runs on pull requests that touch this pipeline. Never scored, never a result, needs no activation.

discovery.definition: The same protocol-defined 100-image, one-per-class discovery sample as the 27B named-baseline plan (strong_baseline.validation_discovery, salt pinned by D13), read from that plan and checked against its ids_sha256.
discovery.role: Validity and cost diagnostic. Its receipt feeds the full-VAL gate and shard count. Not a benchmark score.
discovery.shards_note: Exactly 4 shards (25 images each); the runner refuses any other count.

full.regenerates_discovery_images: Yes: full VAL is its own run; discovery outputs are never copied into it.

gate.requires: A committed discovery receipt (discovery-receipt.json from a merged discovery run) passed as the dispatch input discovery_receipt; it must carry this activated plan's SHA256, status completed and all 100 images completed.
gate.shard_rule: N >= ceil(3333 / floor((shard_wall_seconds - image_seconds - discovery max_fixed_setup_seconds) / (1.5 x (discovery mean_image_latency_seconds + discovery mean_image_fetch_seconds)))). fixed setup = a shard's setup seconds minus its image-fetch seconds (frozen import, model download and rehash, load); fetch seconds are charged per image because a full shard fetches all its images during setup. The matrix command refuses a smaller N.
gate.on_stop: Report the named comparator as incomplete. Do not change prompt, decoding, model, sample or comparators to rescue it.

sharding.assignment: Stage image i in author order belongs to shard i mod N; each shard runs its images in author order.
sharding.start_rule: A shard starts an image only if its elapsed seconds plus image_seconds stay within shard_wall_seconds; otherwise it stops as partial, so no image is cut by the 6 h GitHub job limit.
sharding.stop_rule: A shard stops at its first generation error, interrupted image or budget stop and fails; nothing is retried or regenerated.
merge_refuses: any shard index in [0, N) without a completed shard record, or any unexpected artifact
any image missing, duplicated, out of its partition or outside the stage manifest; every image must be scored exactly once
any non-completed outcome (generation error, unknown after interruption, partial shard)
any shard from a re-run attempt (GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT != 1), another workflow run or another commit
any shard whose model, runtime, profile, generation config, prompt or frozen-source identity differs from the others
any canonical label that differs from the frozen parser applied to the raw response
sharding.runs_policy: Every dispatched VAL run is reported, failed or not. A failed run is never patched by re-running shards; a new dispatch is a new run and the report lists it next to the failed one. The first run that merges is the result for its stage.

analysis.metric: mean(diag(row_normalized_confusion)) via the frozen classification_comparison; micro accuracy supplemental
analysis.comparison_direction: compare_classification(gold, named_baseline, endpoint): candidate is the named baseline, comparator the endpoint, on all 3,333 images and the full vocabulary
analysis.endpoint_export_check: Before any baseline comparison, the merge recomputes compare_classification(gold, arm, common) for RL400 and the strongest SFT from the committed export with the frozen code and requires the full result (scores, per-class differences, bootstrap intervals, input_sha256) to equal versus_common_initialization[arm] in the committed report. The export was made by scripts/export_native_val_endpoint_predictions.py from the evaluator journals whose SHA256 the report records, and it reproduced both input_sha256 values at export time.
analysis.discovery_reporting: numerator, denominator, macro (= micro by balance), Hoeffding interval, valid fraction, unterminated answers, latency and setup seconds; no paired comparison on the 100-image sample
analysis.claim_limits: A named native-VAL baseline claim requires all 3,333 predictions with zero non-completed outcomes from one merged run. VAL was the selection set for the strongest SFT, so a comparison against it is a development comparison. Nothing here touches the frozen native TEST.

runner: scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_ci.py (tests: tests/test_aircraft_named_baseline_ci.py, CPU only, no model)
